crossRefs.note: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
“Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.

in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of…

translations.web: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
translations.bsb: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father.
translations.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
translations.asv: They perceived not that he spake to them of the Father.
